row.notes: Key = {f0, f1, f2, f3, byte b} (0x14 B). If equal to the cached key returns. Otherwise refreshes the bracket indices in the cache for every axis whose value left the cached bracket: axis 0 uses breakpoints at table+0x88 (count +0x198) when f3 != 0, else table+0x58 (count +0x190), indices cache+0x18/+0x20; f1 axis table+0xb8 -> cache+0x28/+0x30; f2 axis table+0xe8 -> cache+0x38/+0x40; f3 axis table+0x118 -> cache+0x48/+0x50; byte axis table+0x178 (count +0x1b8) linear search -> cache+0x58 (-1 if missing). Finally copies key into cache. Used before Ai_Table_InterpolateA/B (axis-0 split matches A=+0x190/B=+0x198).
